name: @tasermonkey/ic10
description: Stationeers IC10 emulator: a modified fork of @stationeers-ic/ic10 for Node 24 ESM, with game-matching instruction fixes

scripts.generate:index: node tools/generate-index.ts && npm run codemod && npm run fix
scripts.generate:instruction: node tools/generate-instruction-index.ts && npm run codemod && npm run fix
scripts.generate:device: node tools/generate-devices.ts && npm run codemod && npm run fix
scripts.generate:vscode: node tools/generate-vscode.ts && npm run codemod && npm run fix
scripts.generate:schema: node tools/generate-schema.ts && npm run codemod && npm run fix
scripts.generate:langs: node tools/generate-langs.ts && npm run codemod && npm run fix
scripts.generate:recipes: node tools/generate-recipes.ts && npm run codemod && npm run fix
scripts.download: node tools/download.ts && npm run codemod && npm run fix
scripts.generate: npm run download:missing && npm run generate:device && npm run generate:instruction && npm run generate:index && npm run generate:schema && npm run generate:vscode && npm run generate:langs
scripts.upgrade: npm run download && npm run generate && npm test
scripts.build: npm run generate && npm test && npm run build:lib
scripts.build:dev: npm run generate && npm test && npm run build:lib -- --mode development
